caption:
The drawing is a colored illustration featuring a large, central map of coastal California, bordered in yellow, orange, and red hues to indicate land areas, with the Pacific Ocean to the left depicted in soft blue tones. At the top center, above the map, are three flags draped over a wheel, colored yellow, white, green, and red, each topped by gold finials. The flags are supported by a piece of ornamental woodwork. The map is encased in an archway and flanked by two columns, each topped with a small balcony decorated with draped cloths—red on the left and blue-green on the right. Along the curved border at the top are small tan and red motifs resembling cattle, a mission bell, and agricultural tools.

On either side of the arch, vertical bands feature small, individual illustrations: on the left, from top to bottom, a hat, a coastline map, a plant, a mission-style building, and a musical instrument; on the right, from top to bottom, a hat, a rope-wrapped blue object, a building, a figure in a green shawl, and peapods or beans. 

At the base, the foreground shows figures in historical dress. On the left, two men (one in blue and one in brown), and a woman in a red skirt and shawl, stand beside a basket of flowers. Next to them, a cow, a man with a lasso, and a woman in a blue skirt are present. In the center, a large ox-drawn cart is positioned in front of a white mission-style building. There is also a large sailing ship on the map’s water area, and a compass rose in yellow and blue. On the right, a standing man in a long blue coat and red scarf is accompanied by a seated man in brown and another woman. There are horses, cattle, and individuals scattered throughout the scene, all drawn in period costumes. The color palette is composed mainly of soft pastels, including greens, blues, reds, browns, and yellows, with fine inked outlines. The title "California Land Grant Study" and a block of printed text are centered above the map, with stylized, decorative fonts.
title: Map: California Land Grant Study
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
